assets.name: timber
assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: production seamless square opaque albedo texture for a fantasy game interior, one material image.
Primary request: Original aged dark walnut / ebonized timber material for a clandestine forest-market interior. Fine vertical wood grain with a few subtle shallow grain channels and restrained worn bronze-brown wear. Readable organic timber detail with quiet variation, nearly black brown base with muted warm brown grain, no separate objects.
Style/medium: slightly painterly realistic late-1990s fantasy-game remake material texture, restrained hand-painted realism.
Composition/framing: strict overhead orthographic flat material scan, square edge-to-edge texture filling the entire image; grain runs vertically. Seamless repeat with opposing image edges matching, no border and no vignette.
Lighting/mood: even neutral albedo illumination across every pixel; no directional light, no baked shadows, no highlights.
Constraints: single square opaque material only. Original design. No room, no perspective, no objects, no ornaments, no metal fittings, no signage, no words, no symbols, no watermark, no montage, no labels. Do not resemble tree bark: timber has fine smooth dense grain, not coarse cracked bark. Do not depict a framed wooden panel. No white margins.

Reconstruction context: recreate this individual material for the existing Black Market, matching its previous material palette in the attached room preview. The preview is a color/style reference only, not the requested output. Produce a single seamless flat opaque square material texture edge to edge. No room, no objects, no text, no montage. Target a 512 by 512 source.
